name: atmt-site-bundle
description: Builds site/assets/js/*.js from src/ (three.js hero + Lenis smooth scroll). Output is committed; Vercel serves it as static files. build:help also writes the offline showcase for the app's Help window (resources/help/showcase.js).

scripts.build: rm -rf ../../site/assets/js && esbuild src/site.js --bundle --splitting --minify --format=esm --target=es2020 --legal-comments=linked --outdir=../../site/assets/js --chunk-names=[name]-[hash] && npm run build:help
